environment.execution_order: Rotate stock, native and forced-window-fallback each trial

notes: All complete-job fixtures compare every result field and RowKind and require native work from the current job.
The forced-window-fallback arm represents previous planner behavior for these previously unsupported value types.
The ungated single-phase overlapping candidate is retained as negative evidence; production keeps those shapes on Flink.
Intermediate tumbling runs precede the final session merge and index ownership optimization; their values are not labeled final-head measurements.
Native timing uses the counting System allocator; complete JVM jobs use mimalloc. Allocation requests are not copied-byte counts.
Timing samples are retained without trimming; short bounded jobs include startup and scheduling.

criterion.timed_boundary: Accounted production update and final flush; session fixtures include a second boundary-touching batch that merges state; setup outside timing, disposal inside timing
